extracted.intended_audience: federal executives and agency personnel with contracting responsibilities
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and training for agency staff responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-76 contracting-out policies, focusing on required studies, documentation, procurement procedures, personnel issues, and QA/QC to ensure compliance and improved governmental efficiency and effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with OMB Circular A-76
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies will be expected to comply with the contracting out policies established in OMB Circular A-76; the Administration's goal is 'improving the efficiency and effectiveness of Government.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OMB will be issuing new policy guidelines by November and all agencies must follow them; the conference will provide a summary of the new OMB changes and an analysis of their implications for all contracting activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conducting Cost Comparison Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost Comparison Studies are identified as one of the two major activities required by A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional full day workshops on Cost Comparison Studies are offered to provide practical, how-to guidance on preparing and executing these studies as required under A-76.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing a Performance Work Statement (PWS)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Performance Work Statement is the other of the two major activities required by A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An optional full day workshop on the Performance Work Statement will teach how to develop the PWS to meet A-76 requirements and support fair, effective contracting decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement process adherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the procurement process aligns with A-76 policy changes and contracting-out requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The conference features expert presentations on the procurement process, including analysis of the new OMB changes and their implications for contracting activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality assurance / quality control procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement QA/QC procedures for contracted functions as part of complying with A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expert presentations at the conference will address quality assurance/quality control procedures to help agencies maintain standards when services are contracted out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addressing personnel issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Manage personnel-related matters arising from contracting out under A-76 (e.g., staffing, employee impacts, classifications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conference sessions include expert presentations on personnel issues to help agencies handle workforce implications of implementing A-76 policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of implementation case studies and practical guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn from implementation case studies that demonstrate practical 'how-to' approaches to applying the new A-76 guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The conference provides implementation case studies designed to give practical guidance and examples of how to implement the new A-76 procedures in real agency contexts.
